title: Make the left Habit block sticky on mobile during horizontal scroll

requirements.text: On mobile only, make the full left Habit info block (the first column containing habit name, unit, volume, and monthly total) remain visible (sticky) while the rest of the habit table scrolls horizontally.

quotes:
1. Yes correct
2. On mobile 
3. Full block

acceptanceCriteria: On a mobile viewport, when the habit grid is horizontally scrolled, the left Habit column stays fixed on the left edge while the day columns scroll behind it.
The sticky behavior applies to both the header cell labeled "Habit" and each habit row’s left info cell.
The sticky column has an opaque background and appropriate z-index so day columns do not visually bleed through underneath it while scrolling.
On tablet/desktop breakpoints, the habit grid behaves as before (no sticky first column).

requirements.text: Update the loading/skeleton state to match the mobile sticky behavior, so the first skeleton column remains sticky during horizontal scrolling on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: On a mobile viewport while the grid skeleton is shown, horizontal scrolling keeps the left skeleton column visible (sticky) while the day skeleton columns scroll.
On tablet/desktop breakpoints, skeleton layout remains unchanged (non-sticky first column).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only Shadcn components).
Do not change backend logic or data models; this is a UI-only layout behavior change.
Implement within the existing HabitGrid/HabitRow/GridSkeleton layout structure and Tailwind styling conventions.
nonGoals: Making the first column sticky on desktop/tablet.
Changing column widths, typography, or habit-row content beyond what is necessary to support sticky behavior.
Adding new authentication, data fetching, or backend endpoints.
